description: GPS speed, motion-state logger and waypoints for vehicles (port of the JP226 ESP32 logger)

store.summary: GPS logger with IMU, waypoint photos, vehicle setup and profile
store.description: Logs GPS tracks to daily CSV files using the JP226 ESP32 logger's timing and unchanged 63-column telemetry schema. Reads the CardputerZero BMI270 IMU, captures camera photos for waypoints even without a GPS fix, and records road, surface, tyre pressure, suspension and load settings. Stores a make/model/year vehicle profile for planned OBD-II readings; OBD connection and OBD logging are not implemented yet. Includes a two-dinosaur Dino Dash.
